_comment: Shrink-only ratchet read by tests/test_skill_quality.py. An entry is the exact measured value of a dimension that is over its threshold. Lower or delete an entry when you slim a skill; never raise one; never add one for an existing skill unless the threshold above was lowered in the same change. Renaming a skill adds an entry, so bring a renamed skill under every threshold first. Regenerate with: python3 tests/skill_quality.py --print-baseline
